items.title: 88:20 · One methodological rule from Section 2 3
items.detail: One methodological rule from Section 2.3.11 closes our analysis: the framework distinguishes Mode 1 Intentional Design, Mode 2 Autonomous Propagation along institutional incentive gradients, and Mode 3 Conscious Intervention.

items.title: 88:32 · That three-mode taxonomy leaves open case by
items.detail: That three-mode taxonomy leaves open case by case whether a specific historical update required conscious coordination or propagated autonomously on inherited institutional firmware.

items.title: 88:41 · The definition closes with the Concession Theorem
items.detail: The definition closes with the Concession Theorem from Chapter 19, which states how reform behaves inside the extraction algorithm's own objective function.

items.title: 88:50 · Equation 19 2 states the theorem the
items.detail: Equation 19.2 states the theorem: the Elite permits or initiates policy reform at a rate proportional to the rising threat from class resistance.

items.title: 88:59 · Each concession is calibrated to keep resistance
items.detail: Each concession is calibrated to keep resistance below the kinetic threshold while preserving the extraction kernel.
